"DETAIL"
In every store there are items that will not be available, if you have not done the following!!:
- Strive to level up your "Farming" skills!!.
- Strive to level up your "Mining" skills!!.
If one of these skills has reached level 7/10 then the shop will open an additional item menu!!.
______________________________________________________________________________________________
"INSTALLATION"
- Download >> Ekstrak File >> Copy/Cut File XNB >> Move to game data folder!!
- Installation in the application : Enter into the game apk file >> Go to the assets folder >> Tab Folder Content >> Tab Folder      Data >> Paste the xnb file that you copied earlier and you're done!!
